ph-neutral-cleaners.title: pH Neutral Cleaning Technology for Industrial Applications
ph-neutral-cleaners.subtitle: Our products make dangerous acid & alkaline cleaners obsolete
ph-neutral-cleaners.intro: We formulate pH neutral cleaners that outperform and replace hazardous alkaline and acidic industrial cleaners used to prepare surfaces for coating and many other cleaning applications. Our formulas enhance employee and environmental safety, reduce maintenance on equipment, and save money across a limitless range of industrial applications including metal parts washing, floor cleaning, equipment maintenance, surface preparation, and more.

sections.heading: Lower Cost

sections.heading: Application Processes
sections.body: Our pH-neutral cleaners work across spray washing, immersion washing, vibratory burr removal, and pressure washing — typically from 130°F to 200°F. Existing alkaline washers can usually be neutralized to transition to pH-neutral products.

card.label: 3D mixing technology
card.title: Drum, pail, and IBC mixers
card.body: EvenMix™ blades equalize vertical, radial, and circular flow, so the whole container blends with no air pulled in.

drum-and-ibc-mixers.title: Drum, Pail, & IBC Mixers Featuring 3D Mixing Technology
drum-and-ibc-mixers.subtitle: A revolution in advanced mixing technology
drum-and-ibc-mixers.intro: 3D MIXING occurs when we equalize the 3 velocity vectors (radial, circular, and vertical) eliminating air inducing vortexes and evenly mixing and blending the total volume of materials in a container.

sections.heading: The Solution Replacing Existing Ineffective Blades
sections.body: Fixed pitch blades create strong vertical velocity vectors drawing in air and leaving materials on the bottom. Impeller-style blades promote vertical movement but lack radial and circular motion, drawing unwanted air into the mix. Radial blades create mostly horizontal motion with almost no vertical or circular mixing. Our 3D approach solves all three.
